Cheerio is part of 5 of my public repositories, from 2016 to 2025.

What it was for: [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (5).

Most recently: [microcrawler-crawler-sreality-cz](@/work/microcrawler-crawler-sreality-cz.md); [microcrawler-crawler-xkcd-com](@/work/microcrawler-crawler-xkcd-com.md); [microcrawler-crawler-yelp-com](@/work/microcrawler-crawler-yelp-com.md).

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Cheerio: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Cheerio to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
